g.text: TrendDetective (data-expansion @ 524818c) — Sequence across the four work areas
keys of all 6 providers (raw keys, no labels)
Point tool, or Areas → click a region
topics, DD.MM.YYYY dates, interval; click Apply
★ deduplicate (WMO / GHCN / ECCC id / same place), keep ≤ 40
bulk fetch, 10 stations per request, 3 in parallel
per code: bin each station → anomaly average
run_tools() per station (LR) and on the area series (selected tools)
records of the nearest station (+ source)
renderVisualization(): cards, SVG chart with dates + unit, LR / t-Test / MK
codes with years, counts, suggestion → "Use … - …" button
pick tools per time frame / per year
